text:
La atención para turistas es realmente pésima. El personal no entiende español, tiene muy mala actitud, miradas desagradables y cero predisposición. A pesar de que el pedido figura claramente en pantalla en su idioma nativo, entregan cualquier cosa.

En varias ocasiones se burlaron o rieron. Cuando reclamás o pedís un cambio en tu comida, no respetan los estándares internacionales de McDonald’s, donde normalmente rehacen el producto. En mi caso, simplemente colocaron las mismas papas que había reclamado en otro recipiente y les agregaron cheddar y bacon. Vi claramente cómo, al notar que yo estaba observando, la empleada se fue al fondo de la cocina con las papas y el cheddar, demorando en regresar, lo cual fue muy incómodo y poco transparente.

Durante mi estadía fui tres veces y ninguna experiencia fue normal: siempre hubo algún problema. En una de esas ocasiones pedí un helado que habíamos seleccionado y confirmado claramente en la pantalla, por lo que el idioma no fue el problema. Además, era de madrugada y no había más clientes con los que pudieran confundirse. Aun así, me entregaron un helado completamente distinto y tuvimos que señalar nuevamente en la pantalla cuál era el correcto.

Además, había niños y adolescentes que no eran empleados junto a una trabajadora, haciendo comentarios desubicados, asumiendo que por hablar español no entendía lo que decían.

Si quieren comer tranquilos, recomiendo elegir otro lugar. En Brasil hay muchos restaurantes donde el personal sí quiere trabajar bien y hacerte sentir cómodo, incluso siendo extranjero.

🇺🇸
The service for tourists is truly terrible. The staff does not understand spanish or english, shows a very poor attitude, gives unpleasant looks, and has no willingness to help. Even though the order is clearly displayed on the screen in their native language, they deliver completely wrong items.

On several occasions, they laughed or mocked customers. When you complain or request a change to your food, they do not follow McDonald’s international standards, where the item is usually remade. In my case, they simply placed the same fries I had complained about into another container and added cheddar and bacon. I clearly saw that when the employee noticed I was watching, she went to the back of the kitchen with the fries and the cheddar, taking a long time to return, which felt uncomfortable and very unprofessional.

During my stay, I went there three times and not a single experience was normal — there was always an issue. On one of those occasions, I ordered an ice cream that we had clearly selected and confirmed on the screen, so the language was not the problem. It was late at night and there were no other customers, leaving no room for confusion. Despite this, we were given a completely different ice cream and had to point at the screen again to show which one we had actually ordered.

Additionally, there were children and teenagers who were not employees standing with an employee, making inappropriate comments and assuming that because I was speaking Spanish, I could not understand what they were saying.

If you want to eat in peace, choose another place. There are many restaurants in Brazil with staff who actually want to work properly and make you feel welcome, even if you are a foreigner.
author: Ariadna Arias

text: O pior restaurante que eu já conheci. Desorganizado, demorado, pessoas gritando números por que a equipe escolhe não usar o placar eletrônico. Todos os meus pedidos vieram errados e tive que troca-lós. Depois de mais de 30min pedi o meu dinheiro de volta e desisti.  A quantidade de pessoas esperando lanche e a quantidade de lanches esperando pessoas - sabe-se lá a quanto tempo - é mais que motivo para se evitar esta loja a todo custo.

text: El helado mas pedido por turistas y brasileros es la casquinha mixta. Hace 3 años seguidos q voy a rio y nunca hay mixta. Solo de crema. Que incluso la maquina no se si es q no funciona bien, pero entrega todos los helados de forma liquida y lo tienen q poner en un vasito. Parrafo aparte si queres ir a comer una hamburguesa; tenes 40 minutos de espera. De por si en brasil la atencion es siempre lenta, pero aca es demasiado

text: If I could give it 0 stars I would , pure trash  food and customer service…. The workers need guidance and training…You have 15 people on fries, 1 person on burgers… Not a place for foreigners… even if you speak the language you will be ignored… felt like a sauna in there, never received my ice cream… I even went to the ice cream station outside … apparently she said they don’t do inside orders… pissy establishment

text:
De longe, é a pior unidade de McDonald’s em Copacabana.
Sempre tem alguma coisa que não tá funcionando como deveria (máquina do catchup, refri ruim, etc).
Não pega sinal de internet no cel e não tem Wi-Fi. Com sorte, você pega uma mesa perto da saída.
Parece que os atendentes têm pena de botar batata frita na embalagem, e te entregam uma batata média com quantidade de batata pequena (sugiro que peçam mais).

text: NO VAYAN por su salud. 0 estrellas. text: I have never experienced such a disgusting McDonalds meal. I ordered a 2 patty burger; they only gave me one. It was cold and tasted awful. My first coffee was left sitting without a lid so it was cold. They then told me they didn’t have any lids this was a take take away. They gave me a larger one, which was still cold. Absolutely disgusting. If I could give zero stars, I would.

Se supone que es un local de comida rápida, pero de rápida no tiene nada. Los empleados ni siquiera están apurados y dan prioridad a los pedidos por aplicación, lo que hace todo mucho más lento para los que estamos en el local
